policy: This is a low-population-server liquidation signal, not a synonym for Low demand. Recommend vendoring exact-Low stock when its remaining buyer case is too narrow and low-value to justify bag space and repeated deposits. Preserve rare materials, valuable gear, practical consumables, conversion inputs, and items that should be sold or crafted only on demand. NPC-vendor convenience-resale items are explicitly excluded.
